user.title: Connect to FrameIT
user.description: Enter the URL and admin credentials for your FrameIT server.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with FrameIT
reauth_confirm.description: The FrameIT admin password for {url} is no longer accepted. Changing it on the server signs every other session out — enter the current credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the FrameIT server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.too_many_attempts: The FrameIT server is temporarily blocking sign-in attempts from Home Assistant. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.already_configured: This FrameIT server is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not find the configuration entry to re-authenticate.
